name: Entertainment Park
access_notes: Entertainment Park is an indoor go-kart/bowling/mini-golf/arcade entertainment complex, not a badminton venue.
notes: Google Place likely confused with Pro1 Badminton Centre, a separate business located next door at 1/361 Milperra Rd, Bankstown Aerodrome NSW 2200 (same street address block but a distinct operator/venue, not confirmed as the same place_id target). Entertainment Park itself has no badminton courts.

name: Sydney Olympic Park Sports Halls
address: Grand Parade, Sydney Olympic Park NSW 2127
access_notes: Multi-purpose sports halls also used for basketball, volleyball, table tennis, pickleball, indoor soccer etc. Casual and association bookings both accepted. Closed public holidays. Parking fees apply on site.
notes: 12 badminton courts on synthetic Pulastic floor, confirmed on Sydney Olympic Park Authority's own site with pricing and Active Carrot booking system.

name: Ultimo Community Centre
address: 40 William Henry St corner Bulwara Rd, Ultimo NSW 2007
access_notes: Single multi-purpose indoor court (3/4-court size) suitable for basketball, volleyball, badminton, indoor soccer, futsal and pickleball. Equipment available for purchase/hire on site. Closed public holidays.
notes: City of Sydney-run centre; badminton is one of several sports the single indoor court is line-marked/equipped for, not a dedicated badminton facility. Court count assumed to be 1 based on description of a single multi-purpose indoor court.

name: Perry Park Recreation Centre
access_notes: 4 multipurpose indoor courts shared across basketball, netball, volleyball, badminton and futsal. City of Sydney-operated, opened as new facility near Green Square. Change facilities, showers, kiosk, free WiFi on site.
notes: Operator site confirms badminton as one of the supported sports on the 4 multipurpose courts, but does not publish per-court badminton pricing; general enquiry email pprcadmin@cityofsydney.nsw.gov.au.

name: Doohan Oval
access_notes: Doohan Reserve/Oval is an outdoor sports precinct with football/AFL/cricket ovals, 8 tennis courts, and multi-use basketball/netball courts. No badminton facilities found. Nearby Oran Park Leisure Centre (a separate venue) offers indoor badminton court hire, but that is not this location.
notes: Confirmed as outdoor tennis/netball/basketball/football reserve, no badminton. Google Places flag appears to be a false positive, possibly proximity confusion with Oran Park Leisure Centre.

name: PCYC Hawkesbury
access_notes: Six-court indoor stadium shared across futsal, netball, basketball, volleyball and badminton. Casual court hire available; bring own equipment. Booking by phone/email (hawkesbury@pcycnsw.org.au).

price_bands.label: Casual badminton court hire
price_bands.notes: Rate per operator page; a third-party listing cited $45/hr — operator page ($40) preferred

notes: Part of the PCYC NSW network; badminton confirmed as an offered activity at the Hawkesbury branch's 6-court stadium.

name: JS Sports Arena
access_notes: Dedicated indoor badminton/pickleball facility with 11 competition-level courts, sprung wooden floors, BWF-approved mats. Operates 7 days; exact daily open/close times not published, but pricing tiers indicate operation from roughly 6am to after 10pm daily. Racket/paddle hire ($5) and stringing service available.
notes: Recently opened dedicated badminton/pickleball venue; 11 total courts split between badminton and pickleball (exact split not published, so courts_badminton reflects total court count, not badminton-only count).

name: Warriewood Valley Sports Court
access_notes: Outdoor multi-sport hard courts (4 courts + a half basketball court) primarily used for netball/basketball; Northern Beaches Council site does not list badminton among supported sports and courts are outdoor (no wind-sheltered indoor badminton play possible).
notes: Confirmed outdoor netball/basketball hard courts, no badminton offered or feasible outdoors at this venue.
